:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--input_gp_mask`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
JSON file containing a nested dictionary containing the gene programs,
with keys being gene program names and values being dictionaries with keys `targets` and `sources`,
where `targets` contains a list of the names of genes in the gene program for the reconstruction of the gene expression of the node itself (receiving node)
and `sources` contains a list of the names of genes in the gene program for the reconstruction of the gene expression of the node's neighbors (transmitting nodes).
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"prior_knowledge_gp_mask.json"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--modality`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Which modality from the input MuData file to process.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"rna"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--layer`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Input layer containing raw counts to be use. If None, X is used
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--var_input`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Key in adata.var that indicates which features to include as input for the NicheCompass model.
If not provided, all features will be included.

`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"filter_with_hvg"`

### NicheCompass Model Architecture

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="columnheader"}
Description
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="columnheader"}
Attributes
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--covariate_edges`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
List of booleans that indicate whether there can be edges between different categories of the categorical covariates.
If this is `True` for a specific categorical covariate, this covariate will be excluded from the edge reconstruction loss.
Needs to match the length and order of `--input_obs_covariates`.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `boolean`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--covariate_embedding_injection_layers`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
List of VGPGAE modules in which the categorical covariates embeddings are injected.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"gene_expr_decoder"`, `"chrom_access_decoder"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"encoder"`, `"gene_expr_decoder"`, `"chrom_access_decoder"`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--include_edge_recon_loss`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Whether to include the edge reconstruction loss in the backpropagation.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--include_gene_expr_recon_loss`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Whether to include the gene expression reconstruction loss in the backpropagation.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--include_cat_covariates_contrastive_loss`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Whether to include the categorical covariates contrastive loss in the backpropagation.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--gene_expr_recon_dist`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The distribution used for gene expression reconstruction.
If `nb`, uses a negative binomial distribution.
If `zinb`, uses a zero-inflated negative binomial distribution.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"nb"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"nb"`, `"zinb"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--log_variational`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Whether to transform x by log(x+1) prior to encoding for numerical stability (not for normalization).
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--node_label_method`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Node label method that will be used for omics reconstruction.
If `one-hop-sum`, uses a concatenation of the node's input features with the sum of the input features of all nodes in the node's one-hop neighborhood.
If `one-hop-norm`, uses a concatenation of the node's input features with the node's one-hop neighbors input features normalized as per Kipf, T. N. & Welling, M. Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks. arXiv [cs.LG] (2016).
If `one-hop-attention`, uses a concatenation of the node's input features with the node's one-hop neighbors input features weighted by an attention mechanism.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"one-hop-norm"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"one-hop-norm"`, `"two-hop-norm"`, `"one-hop-attention"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--active_gp_thresh_ratio`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Ratio that determines which gene programs are considered active and are used in the latent representation after model training.
All inactive gene programs will be dropped during model training after a determined number of epochs.
Aggregations of the absolute values of the gene weights of the gene expression decoder per gene program are calculated.
The maximum value, i.e. the value of the gene program with the highest aggregated value will be used as a benchmark and all gene programs whose aggregated value is smaller than `--active_gp_thresh_ratio` times this maximum value will be set to inactive.
If set to 0, all gene programs will be considered active.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.1`

[Min]{.arg-key} `0.0`

[Max]{.arg-key} `1.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--active_gp_type`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Type to determine active gene programs.
Can be `mixed`, in which case active gene programs are determined across prior and add-on gene programs jointly,
or `separate` in which case they are determined separately for prior and add-on gene programs.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"separate"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"mixed"`, `"separate"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--n_fc_layers_encoder`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Number of fully connected layers in the encoder before message passing layers.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `1`

[Min]{.arg-key} `0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--n_layers_encoder`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Number of message passing layers in the encoder.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `1`

[Min]{.arg-key} `0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--n_hidden_encoder`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Number of nodes in the encoder hidden layers.
  If not provided, it will be determined automatically based on the number of input genes and gene programs.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Min]{.arg-key} `0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--conv_layer_encoder`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Convolutional layer used as GNN in the encoder.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"gatv2conv"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"gcnconv"`, `"gatv2conv"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--encoder_n_attention_heads`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Number of attention heads used in the GNN layers of the encoder.
Only relevant if `--conv_layer_encoder gatv2conv`.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `4`

[Min]{.arg-key} `0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--encoder_use_bn`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Whether to use a batch normalization layer at the end of the encoder to normalize `mu`.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `false`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--dropout_rate_encoder`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Probability that nodes will be dropped in the encoder during training.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.0`

[Min]{.arg-key} `0.0`

[Max]{.arg-key} `1.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--dropout_rate_graph_decoder`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Probability that nodes will be dropped in the graph decoder during training.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.0`

[Min]{.arg-key} `0.0`

[Max]{.arg-key} `1.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--n_addon_gp`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Number of addon gene programs (i.e. gene programs that are not included in masks but can be learned de novo).
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `100`

[Min]{.arg-key} `0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--cat_covariates_embeds_nums`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Number of embedding nodes for all categorical covariates.

List of `integer`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`

:::: {.arg-row role="row"}

`--random_state`

Random seed for reproducibility.

[Min]{.arg-key} `0`

[Min]{.arg-key} `0`
:::

:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--n_epochs_no_cat_covariates_contrastive`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Number of epochs during which the categorical covariates contrastive loss is excluded from backpropagation for pretraining using the other loss components.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Min]{.arg-key} `0`

`--lr`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Learning rate
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.001`

[Min]{.arg-key} `0.0`

[Max]{.arg-key} `1.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--weight_decay`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Weight decay (L2 penalty).
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.001`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--lambda_edge_recon`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Lambda (weighting factor) for the edge reconstruction loss.
If `>0`, this will enforce gene programs to be meaningful for edge reconstruction and, hence, to preserve spatial colocalization information.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `500000.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--lambda_gene_expr_recon`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Lambda (weighting factor) for the gene expression reconstruction loss.
If `>0`, this will enforce interpretable gene programs that can be combined in a linear way to reconstruct gene expression.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `300.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--lambda_cat_covariates_contrastive`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Lambda (weighting factor) for the categorical covariates contrastive loss.
If `>0`, this will enforce observations with different categorical covariates categories with very similar latent representations to become more similar, and observations with different latent representations to become more different.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--contrastive_logits_pos_ratio`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Ratio for determining the logits threshold of positive contrastive examples of node pairs from different categorical covariates categories.
The top (`contrastive_logits_pos_ratio` * 100)% logits of node pairs from different categorical covariates categories serve as positive labels for the contrastive loss.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.0`

[Min]{.arg-key} `0.0`

[Max]{.arg-key} `1.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--contrastive_logits_neg_ratio`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Ratio for determining the logits threshold of negative contrastive examples of node pairs from different categorical covariates categories.
The bottom (`contrastive_logits_neg_ratio` * 100)% logits of node pairs from different categorical covariates categories serve as negative labels for the contrastive loss.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.0`

[Min]{.arg-key} `0.0`

[Max]{.arg-key} `1.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--lambda_group_lasso`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Lambda (weighting factor) for the group lasso regularization loss of gene programs.
If `>0`, this will enforce sparsity of gene programs.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--lambda_l1_masked`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Lambda (weighting factor) for the L1 regularization loss of genes in masked gene programs.
If `>0`, this will enforce sparsity of genes in masked gene programs.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--l1_targets_categories`
:::

Gene program mask targets categories for which l1 regularization loss will be applied.

List of `string`

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_spatial \
  -r v0.7.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/nichecompass/nichecompass/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline_spatial/v0.7.0/components/nichecompass/nichecompass);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_spatial \
  -r v0.7.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/nichecompass/nichecompass/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
